meta.title: Integrations
meta.description: Four short guides: Vite, the Next.js App Router, React Router in framework mode, and server rendering.

scope: The component is a plain React component with no framework of its own, so an integration is usually three lines: install it, import the stylesheet once, render it. These pages are the specifics — where the stylesheet goes, which side of the server boundary the schedule lives on, and what to hand it so that both renders agree.
